definitions.gloss: ability to respond, adaptability, coping ability
definitions.explanation: The capacity to handle situations, respond to changes, or deal with problems effectively. Commonly used in business and personal development contexts.

examples.japanese: {対応力|たいおうりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: People with strong adaptability are in demand.

examples.japanese: ⟦トラブル→トラブル：07061_toraburu⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{対応力|たいおうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ (response, coping) + {力|りょく} (ability, power). The suffix {力|りょく} is productive and attaches to many nouns to mean "ability to do X."

SIMILAR COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{適応力|てきおうりょく}→適応力：14971_tekiouryoku⟧: adaptability (to environments)
- {対処力|たいしょりょく}: coping ability
- ⟦{応用力|おうようりょく}→応用力：21107_ouyouryoku⟧: ability to apply knowledge

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対応力|たいおうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to improve one's ability to respond
- {対応力|たいおうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have adaptability
- {対応力|たいおうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問|と}われる→問う：02299_tou⟧: adaptability is tested
